blocks.text: Bohat se toxic materials environment ka hissa bante ja rahe hain. Yahan example ke taur par do major concerns (bari fikrein) parhenge: plastics aur heavy metals. Yeh materials apni achhi (superior) properties ki wajah se aam use hote hain, lekin in ke long-term effects (lambe arse ke asraat) lethal (jaan-leva) hain.

Heavy Metals: lead (Pb), mercury (Hg) aur cadmium (Cd) aam taur par electronics, batteries aur fluorescent lights mein milti hain. Yeh zameen ke neeche ke pani (groundwater) mein ja sakti hain aur wahan se jandaron (living organisms) tak pohanch jati hain.

blocks.alt: Pb, Hg, Cd: 'electronics, batteries, fluorescent lights' se teer 'groundwater' tak, aur wahan se teer 'living organisms' tak.
blocks.caption: Heavy metals jandaron tak kaise pohanchti hain (hamari apni drawing; kitab ki figure nahi).

blocks.text: Plastics: bohat se plastics mein phthalates ya bisphenol A (BPA) jaise toxic additives hote hain jo hormones ke kaam mein interfere kar (khalal daal) sakte hain. Microplastics (plastic ke bohat chhote zarre) ab samandar, mitti aur khane tak mein milte hain, aur insani zindagi aur ecosystems par lambe arse ka asar dalte hain. Insanon mein microplastics ke carcinogenic (cancer paida karne wale) hone ka suspicion (shak) hai, lekin yeh abhi sabit nahi hua.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke insanon mein microplastics carcinogenic 'paye gaye' hain. Microplastics insani jism mein mile hain aur sehat par in ke asar par research jari hai, lekin yeh sabit nahi hua ke yeh insanon mein cancer karte hain. Is liye sahi baat yeh hai ke in ke carcinogenic hone ka shak (suspected) hai.

blocks.prompt: Lead, mercury aur cadmium aam taur par kahan milte hain?
blocks.explanation: Electronics, batteries aur fluorescent lights mein.

items: Heavy metals Pb, Hg, Cd: electronics, batteries, fluorescent lights; groundwater se jandaron tak.
Plastic additives (phthalates, BPA) hormones par asar karte hain; microplastics har jagah mil rahe hain.
